claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch without a material-weakness disclosure, based on aggregate readiness passing, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public governance guidance, while treating the named student-aid advising gap as a residual risk rather than a blocking disclosure issue.
decision_criteria: If there is a material limitation affecting a named launch use case, it must be disclosed unless resolved before launch or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Evidence of aggregate readiness can support general launch readiness but cannot override a specific disclosure condition.
Open legal review increases uncertainty and does not satisfy a required approval or disclosure predicate.
Admissible evidence must directly support the certification path actually taken, not just a narrower or different governance rationale.
evidence_requests: Approved risk-acceptance record explicitly covering the student aid advising gap for launch.
Final legal determination on whether the gap must be disclosed.
Evidence that the 1.2 percentage point gap was resolved before launch.
The actual launch disclosure or model-card text showing the limitation was disclosed for the named use case.
specific_concerns: The policy states that material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The student aid advising segment misses target and is named in two university pilot commitments, which makes the limitation material under the stated policy.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, so the disclosure predicate is unresolved.
No admissible evidence shows the gap was resolved before launch.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering launch without disclosure.
Aggregate readiness and lack of severity-one incidents do not satisfy the separate policy requirement for disclosure of a material named-use-case limitation.
unsupported_claims: That certification without a material-weakness disclosure is policy-compliant.
That public model-card or AI risk-management guidance can substitute for the repo-specific disclosure requirement.
That the launch decision can properly rest on aggregate readiness alone despite an unresolved material named-use-case gap.
Any implication that the open legal review supports proceeding without disclosure.
